rows.claim: Unit 1046 fires on edit-type repetition (edit/revert blocks recurring) combined with repeated failures and no progress, and adds its activation to the ` looping` logit only, so A/B edit cycles and edit/revert cycles are named looping instead of recovering.

Unit 1613 fires when identical failing blocks or a long retry chain dominate the window without a resolution, progress or edit repetition, and adds its activation to the ` stalled` logit only, so repeated identical failures are named stalled instead of recovering or looping.

Unit 1007 reads errors-present times recent-success and moves only the ` recovering` logit, lowering it on stalled windows and raising it in the blocks after a resolution, so recovering is named for resolved or in-policy retries rather than as the default for every error.

The ` productive` row gains the progress-plus-resolution-minus-repeated-failure direction of the final residual, so windows with progress or new investigation are named productive even when error lines are in context.
